purpose: Defines the single MIRLEX Engine source packages consumed by expert interfaces. Expert interfaces do not own independent rule copies.

exclude: ROP-only rules unless cross-contour trigger explicitly links them

retrieval_contract.response_logic: Retrieve only relevant rules; ask only questions that can change route, legal branch, internal risk, scope, price, timing, laboratory/site visit need or quote inputs.
retrieval_contract.future_delivery: The repository remains canonical. Expert connection may use API retrieval/file search/vector store or another connector layer; do not manually fork rule logic into separate expert knowledge bases.

release_gate: regression test exists for material branching
